aboutParagraphs: Brown County Plumbing is an owner-operated plumbing company based in Nashville, Indiana. Owner-plumber Mike Miller started the company in 2021 to serve customers across Brown County.

We handle everyday plumbing service, water heaters, water treatment, and water line installation and repair. You'll find us on the Brown County Water Utility's courtesy list of local water line providers.
The easiest way to reach us is to call or text (812) 276-7943.
